name: phase338-groq-llama33-vault-diagnostic-redaction
probe_prompt: Return one raw JSON object only. First byte {; last byte }; no fences or extra text. A runtime tried to construct a provider while its encrypted credential vault was locked. Provider construction failed closed before any provider request. The external diagnostic wraps the vault-locked cause but must not include the configured credential-reference name, secret value, or a healthy/success result. The model cannot unlock or retry. Exact keys/types: construction_succeeds=false; cause_preserved=true; credential_reference_exposed=false; secret_exposed=false; model_can_unlock_or_retry=false; canonical_writes=0.
